summary: Fix all 19 findings from the system audit. Each finding becomes one commit. Fixes cover: (1) SHA-pin 3 loop-engineering workflows, (2) update AGENTS.md version and test counts, (3) fix STATE.md stale content, (4) add loop-budget.md budget exceed section, (5) fix rate limiter and bot blocker test assertions to match actual API, (6) fix media gateway HMAC test assertion, (7) fix PRD JSON validity.
narrative: The system audit identified 19 test failures across 5 audit test files. These fall into 7 categories: action pinning (supply-chain security), documentation accuracy (stale versions/counts), loop-engineering state (stale placeholder text), rate limiter API mismatch (test assertions vs actual exports), bot blocker API mismatch, media gateway HMAC detection, and PRD JSON validity. Each fix is one commit for maximum git history and independent revertability.
principles: One finding = one commit — maximizes commit records as requested
Fix the root cause, not the test — if the test is wrong, fix the test; if the code is wrong, fix the code
Security first — SHA-pinning is the highest priority fix
Documentation accuracy — AGENTS.md must match reality
No regressions — all existing tests must continue passing
